name: Alpha Vantage
tagline: Free stock, forex, crypto, and economic time series API for market data.
description: Alpha Vantage provides real-time and historical market data via a REST API covering equities, forex, cryptocurrencies, technical indicators, and macroeconomic indicators. Developers authenticate with a free API key and call function-based endpoints that return JSON or CSV. A free tier is available with daily request caps; paid premium plans raise rate limits and unlock higher-frequency data.

auth.details: API key via apikey query parameter; free self-serve key from the website.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 25 requests/day free (as of recent docs — verify current)
pricing.paid_plans: Premium plans available for higher limits

use_cases: get latest stock quote for a ticker
fetch daily historical OHLCV for a symbol
compute technical indicators for a stock
